replies.author: AlgaeNo3373
replies.body: I'm assuming OP meant literally free and not freemium etc. I.e. there is no monetization.

replies.author: bingewavecinema

replies.author: AlgaeNo3373
replies.body:
What's the line of thinking there? Care to share your CoT? :P 

Something can be a labour of love and not monetized.   
Something can be monetized and soulless predatory slop.   
  
I don't see how monetization/slop are that intrinsically related. Curious how/why you do.

replies.author: QuestHouseGM
replies.body: Clearly nobody has ever done anything for any reason other than conjuring up that sweet sweet skrilla.

replies.author: Tasty-Ad-3753
replies.body: Yeah, maybe it sounds naiive - people will still try to monetise games - but I also feel like it will be so easy and cheap to create good quality web games that it would be impossible for there not to be a lot of very high quality free ones.

replies.author: AlgaeNo3373
replies.body: Makes sense to me too, maybe we're both naive :P
